scope_statement: PLC Injuries, as it is acquired and interpreted.
source_note: No sources were retrieved. The generation environment had no access to PubMed, Cochrane, any journal or any textbook. The Tier 1 source minimum is NOT met and this draft would not pass Tier 1 in the deployed pipeline. This section is written entirely for professionals, and it is unverified.
claims_needing_verification: The original scan usually shows what was not reported.
A chronic injury may have no identifiable structures.
Varus alignment is part of the problem and the operation.
A rotational profile adds to a mismatched picture.
The report lists components with their state.
claims_note: Listed above are the substantive claims, taken from the deepest tier's key learning points. Every statement about an appearance, a sequence or an artefact in the page body requires the same verification; these are the ones a reviewer should start with.
content_rule: Decision 006: this page may carry measurements and every one of them is written from standard teaching rather than from a retrieved paper. None has been checked against a source, because the build environment has none. Each figure is registered in pipeline/config/figures/<page_id>.json with the sentence it supports and a verification state. Run tools/figures.py --report --unchecked for the outstanding list. Decision 028 adds a restriction to this section: no sensitivity, specificity, predictive value or likelihood ratio appears on any imaging page, because the comparative standing of the modalities is standard teaching and a specific percentage written from memory is the same class of claim as an invented citation. ACC-001 refuses it at the gate, including the adjective forms, which that rule did not catch until decision 028 went looking.
gaps_or_uncertainties: No measurement appears on this page. Where one would normally sit the page gives the relationship instead, because the value is not one this environment can state with confidence.

No diagnostic accuracy figure appears on this page, under decision 028. Every claim about how good a modality or a sequence is, is stated as a comparison rather than a number, and the comparison is a judgement a reviewer must agree with rather than look up.

This page's tier set, boundary list and scope sentence come from decision 027, because Part 1 maps Section 5 in one sentence and Part 2 is not in this repository. Part 1 states no tier set for Section 5 at all, which makes this weaker than Section 4's derivation, where one sentence named the tiers.
The imaging template itself is unvalidated. Decision 028 invented it and no editorial authority has confirmed its six sections.
architecture_check: Written against the architecture's own brief for 5.10.3, including its must_not_cover list: Clinical examination technique and interpretation (owned by Section 4); Clinical management and treatment selection (owned by Section 6); Operative technique (owned by Section 7); Structure level anatomy beyond what the image shows (owned by Section 2); Biomechanics beyond what the appearance depends on (owned by Section 3); Appearance on another modality or of another structure (owned per chapter by 5.2 to 5.20)
